- SOC 2 Type II report (full report, auditor opinion, and system description).
- Bridge letter if the report's coverage ends prior to our expected go-live (target coverage through 2026-03-31).

Hi Helen — thanks for the clear list and timeline. Happy to help; below is what we can share immediately and our suggested workflow.

Immediate items we will provide by 2026-03-18:
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted copy): auditor opinion, system description, and testing period.
- A one-page SOC 2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) that highlights controls relevant to Acme (auth, data protection, change mgmt).
- Bridge letter covering the gap from the report end date to 2026-03-31 if needed (see note below).
- A list of subservice organizations and the scope of their controls.

Optional / available on request or via secure portal:
- Raw test-of-control artifacts (log samples, screenshots). We prefer to share these through our secure portal rather than email.
- CAIQ / SIG spreadsheet: we can pre-populate the standard SIG rows that map to SOC 2 controls.

Redaction and delivery: we can redact customer-specific identifiers (customer names, IP addresses) from the PDF and deliver via a time-limited secure link. If your legal team needs an unredacted copy, we typically ask for an NDA and a short non-disclosure form; consultco can sign if required.

Standard reply template you can reuse when asking for artifacts internally (feel free to copy):
"We have received the vendor's SOC 2 Type II (redacted) and a SOC 2 summary. Requested artifacts are available in a secure portal: [secure link]. For unredacted reports, vendor requires an NDA. Auditor: [auditor name]. Testing period: [start_date] — [end_date]."

Next steps from our side: Marissa (cc) will upload the redacted report and SOC 2 summary to a secure share and post a DocuSign link for the bridge letter if you confirm the required coverage dates. Rafael (cc) is on standby for any procurement or contract clarifications.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (application/pdf)

Best,
